en.title: Criminal Minds Star Paget Brewster Finally Gives Voice to Obscure Disney Character
en.summary: Paget Brewster, known for her intense role on Criminal Minds, has lent her voice to a surprisingly significant, yet long-overlooked, Disney character. This marks a major moment for a figure previously confined to animation's footnotes.
en.body:
Paget Brewster has carved out a formidable presence on television as **SSA Emily Prentiss** in the long-running crime drama **Criminal Minds**. Her ability to portray complex, driven characters in gritty, realistic scenarios is undeniable. However, Brewster's talents extend far beyond the procedural world, venturing into the vibrant landscape of animation, and most notably, giving a voice to a pivotal, yet historically understated, Disney character.

Brewster is the voice behind **Della Duck**, a character who, until recently, existed largely in the periphery of Disney's vast universe. "I play the character Della Duck who, so far, has been obscure, not written about much," Brewster shared in an interview. This obscurity belies Della's importance within the Duck family tree, a lineage familiar to generations of fans through iconic figures like **Donald Duck** and **Scrooge McDuck**. Brewster's casting signifies a deliberate effort to elevate Della from a mere footnote in Disney lore to a central player in a new animated series, finally bringing her narrative potential to the forefront.

## Della Duck's Journey from Obscurity to the Spotlight

For years, Della Duck remained a character more often mentioned than seen, a tantalizing presence whose full story was largely untold. Her significance was a known quantity to dedicated Disney historians and lore enthusiasts, but for the average viewer, she was an enigmatic figure. Brewster's portrayal finally bridges that gap, allowing audiences worldwide to connect with Della on a deeper level. This transformation from an obscure character to a major player in an animated series is a testament to the power of dedicated storytelling and inspired casting, proving that even the most hidden corners of a beloved franchise can yield compelling narratives.

## What This Means for Disney Fans

For dedicated fans of the **DuckTales** universe and Disney animation at large, this development is incredibly exciting. It represents a commitment from Disney to delve deeper into its own rich history, unearthing characters with untapped potential. Brewster's involvement adds a layer of gravitas and proven talent, assuring viewers that Della's newfound prominence will be handled with care and depth. This move not only enriches the existing tapestry of Disney characters but also signals potential for further explorations of familial dynamics and untold stories within the broader Disney canon, appealing directly to binge-watchers eager for new layers to their favorite worlds.

## What's Next

While specific details regarding future seasons or the full scope of Della Duck's arc in the animated series have not yet been announced, Paget Brewster's continued involvement promises compelling storytelling. Fans can anticipate more of her nuanced performance bringing this vital Disney character to life.

content_raw: Paget Brewster may thrive in the gritty dark world of Criminal Minds, but she's also a proven voice actor with animated Disney credits to her name.
